name: extract -> normalise -> validate (model reads, code parses)

slots.name: CONV_JUDGE
slots.doc: reads the source's note: enum fields (each with none) and a quote

when.instructions: Must values be read out of free text or of documents with differing layouts before any calculation?
How do the inputs state their conventions (dates, units, currency)?

criteria.stated-per-source: each source states its own convention in prose
criteria.implicit: it has to be inferred from the values

checklist.text: Quote check on every reading judge.
Minor units for money; never floats.
Default or fallback values must be explicit and flagged.
checklist.enforcedBy: rejected rows go to review with a reason, or deopt

checklist.text: A batch or chunk size bounds each read.
No chain-of-thought field in an extraction schema.

Per-source date order, sign and perspective conventions are read once as a global configuration (evidence quote per decision, an explicit rule that a worked example decides, k >= 3 agreement or the strong tier); a consequence check flips each convention in a copy and confirms the output changes as the notes require.
A spec clause that admits two readings that change an output set is flagged with the clause quoted, never silently chosen.

slots.PARSE: (src) => src.csv.trim().split('\n').slice(1).map((l, i) => { const [date, amount] = l.split(','); return { id: src.id + ':' + (i + 1), date, amountMinor: Math.round(Number(amount) * 100) }; })

CONV_JUDGE.system: From the note only: in this export's numeric dates, does the day or the month come first? Quote the sentence that says so; answer none with an empty quote if the note does not say.

slots.NORMALISE: (r, conv) => { const [a, b, y] = r.date.split('/').map(Number); const dm = conv.order === 'DMY' ? [a, b] : conv.order === 'MDY' ? [b, a] : null; return { ...r, date: dm ? y + '-' + String(dm[1]).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(dm[0]).padStart(2, '0') : null }; }
slots.VALIDATE: (r) => { const [y, m, d] = r.date.split('-').map(Number); return y > 1900 && m >= 1 && m <= 12 && d >= 1 && d <= 31; }
